invariant: Move one leaf, non-main Go package directory within one root module and rewrite only go/parser-confirmed exact import string literals.

native_model.module: one root go.mod; workspaces and nested modules are unsupported
native_model.minimum_version: Go 1.22 or the higher root go.mod directive

outcomes.complete: exact after-tree, targeted gofmt, exact source-diff oracle, and go test ./... succeed
outcomes.partial: a concrete old import path occurs outside an AST ImportSpec literal
outcomes.unsupported: tool, module, package shape, generated/vendor/symlink, cgo, build-tag, or generator boundary is outside this pilot
outcomes.failed: malformed Go, helper failure, native verification failure, or exact-diff mismatch; apply rolls back

tooling_evidence: PATH-discovered /opt/homebrew/bin/go and gofmt; local version go1.26.5; installed commands do not hardcode that path.
next_language_guidance: Use a native parser only for the exact fact needed; do not promote a one-package mutation adapter into a shared refactoring runtime without a second accepted consumer.
